title: DEMO
fullscreenUnavailable: Browser fullscreen is unavailable. The demo still fills this window.
practiceControls: Use your direction keys, controller, swipe the board, or tap these arrows.
steer: Practice: steer, bend your cut and reconnect on safe ground. Pause to choose another action.
practicePaused: Practice paused. Choose Continue practice, then give a fresh direction.
practiceComplete: Practice complete. No scores, pictures or progress were awarded. Try from the beginning or return to the demo.
recapWin: Level complete · {{percent}}% captured. Ready to try your own route?
recapLoss: Signal lost. Even a good route can fail — watch the next pilot adapt.
blurredPicture: Scrambled preview. Earn the original picture in normal play.
tipStart: Watch real gameplay: leave safe ground, turn, then reconnect to capture an area.
tipCut: The unfinished line is vulnerable. Plan a route back to safe ground.
tipClose: A closed cut captures territory. Watch which area opens and where the next route begins.
tipStop: Closing a cut stops the craft in this chapter. Give a new direction for the next move.
tipLane: Lane attacks mark their path before activating. Use the warning to move clear.
tipPickup: This chapter has supplies. Watch how collecting them supports the next cut.
tipPowerup: A contact pickup changes play automatically. Watch the craft and enemies react.
tipAbility: The craft used its equipment. Each role helps with a different kind of opening.
tipScan: A scan can reveal nearby hidden objectives. Capture their ground to secure them.
tipObjective: An objective was captured with the territory. Finish by reaching the area target and capturing every required objective.
tipSignal: Interference zones can slow the craft or block equipment. Plan a route around them or use a resistant craft.
tipClass: A safe hangar lets the player change craft and keep each role’s remaining equipment.
tipFailure: A mistake costs a life. Watch the recovery, then choose a safer return route.
tipImpact: An impact is travelling along the line. Reconnect before it reaches the craft.
unavailable: No compatible demo is available right now. Your game is unchanged.
loadError: The demo could not load. You can try again; your game is unchanged.
takeoverError: This position could not be prepared. Keep watching or try another demonstration.
auto: Show a demo after 60 seconds on the idle home screen
collect: Use my successful runs in demos
hidePictures: Hide every demo picture behind signal noise
hiddenPicture: Picture hidden by your demo privacy setting.
localOnly: Recordings stay on this device. The disposable demo cache holds up to 12 recordings / 32 MiB and is separate from saved flights.
cleared: Your demo recordings were cleared. Saved flights and progress are unchanged.
cacheError: The demo cache is unavailable. Saved flights and progress are unchanged.
settingsSessionOnly: These demo settings apply for this visit; device storage is unavailable.
kept: This run is kept for demos on this device.
notKept: Complete a normal run with varied movement to keep it for demos.
boundControls: Directions: {{directions}} · Pause: {{pause}} · Esc: back to home
audio.failed: Audio could not start. Try again.
